title: Serious Sam - The Second Encounter - host a LAN game

vars.GTITLE: Serious Sam - The Second Encounter - Host LAN

prelaunch:
echo.
echo  Other players need THIS machine address:
ipconfig | findstr /i "IPv4 Address"
echo.
echo  On every other machine: put that address on the first line of
echo  C:\Games\lanhost.txt and run the matching Join shortcut.
echo.
postlaunch:
rem Serious Engine 1 cannot open a listen server from the command line -
rem SeriousSam.exe accepts only +level/+game/+cdpath/+password/+connect/
rem +script/+goto (read out of the binary). So the host runs the DEDICATED
rem server and then joins it on the loopback, which puts a player at this
rem end too - a two-box proof needs a game on BOTH screens.
rem
rem The client does NOT retry: it reports "server not responding" and drops
rem to the menu, which reads exactly like a server that never started.
ping -n 17 127.0.0.1 >nul
if not defined DISCDRV (
    echo.
    echo  ============================================================
    echo   The dedicated server is UP and other machines can join it.
    echo   This machine has no disc mounted, so the game itself cannot
    echo   start here. That is EXPECTED on a box with no disc mounter -
    echo   DedicatedServer.exe has no CD check and SeriousSam.exe does.
    echo  ============================================================
    ping -n 11 127.0.0.1 >nul
    goto :theend
)
start "" /D "%~dp0" "%~dp0Bin\SeriousSam.exe" +connect 127.0.0.1
_note: REQUIREDISC=0 IS LOAD-BEARING HERE, not the conservative default. DedicatedServer.exe has NO CD check - no GetDriveTypeA import, no +cdpath, no 'Please insert the game CD' string - so this shortcut carries no disc_mount capability in requires.json and must still run on a box with no mounter at all. VERIFIED 2026-08-31: .123 (no optical drive, no mounter) hosted a three-box LAN game for .133 and .240. The local client in postlaunch is started ONLY when DISCDRV is defined, because the CLIENT does check for the disc - that is the per-shortcut split expressed rather than papered over. MARKER is a per-disc .gro and deliberately NOT Install\Bin\SeriousSam.exe, which is the file the CD check itself opens: it is on BOTH Encounters' discs, so it would let the wrong one report success. Same class as BF1942's Setup.ini marker.
